claims: All Publix stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Publix closes for only three holidays per year.
Publix closes on Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.
Publix stores will operate with normal hours on Saturday.
Publix stores will reopen on Monday, April 6.
Walmart, Whole Foods, and Trader Joe's are generally open on Easter.
Target, Aldi, and Costco are closed on Easter.
